node.control.signalWatchdog.name: Signal Watchdog
node.control.signalWatchdog.description: Monitor from automatic workflow startup, even before the first heartbeat. Each heartbeat resets the timeout. Silence emits one fallback signal; the next heartbeat stops listeners started by that fallback and rearms monitoring. Already accepted work can finish. Choose one monitoring PC independent of the primary sender.
watchdog.target: Choose one fixed monitoring PC or the coordinator.
watchdog.unavailable: The monitoring runtime is unavailable or the nested scope limit was reached.
source.scope.closed: The fallback has ended; this listener was not started.
source.scope.invalid: The listener lifetime information is invalid.
source.scope.unconfirmed: The fallback owner could not confirm that the listener may start.
source.scope.stopUnconfirmed: Some fallback listeners did not confirm shutdown.
source.scope.unsupported: Update the target Core before starting this fallback path.
source.scope.unavailable: The execution target cannot preserve listener ownership.
